A '''''Rebel Resistance Poster''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was a [[Propaganda/Legends|recruitment]] poster requesting youths to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]], with an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] standing over a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the [[Alliance Starbird|Rebel Starbird]] logo behind the pilot and Aurebesh writing. It was often sold and/or put up during [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, although they sometimes ended up torn off by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] officials. Despite their animosity, some Imperial officials would sometimes sell them during festivities alongside the Imperial Recruitment posters.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Resistance Poster is sold during Empire Day festivities for 20x Rememberance Day tokens or for 20x Empire Day tokens.
